scope: FP32 fixed-shape segmented streaming acoustic-decoder host sequence

interface.cached_entry: latent [1,64,1] plus 34 cache tensors -> PCM [1,1,3200] plus 34 updated cache tensors

design.selected: eight sequential XNNPACK PTE segments for each entry type
design.reason: The monolithic streaming PTE exported but terminated the host runtime. Eight boundaries aligned with the seven decoder stages plus head execute correctly.
design.causal_conv_rewrite: 28 SConv1d modules use export-safe explicit-cache semantics.

validation.cached_call_cache_source: Actual call-0 ExecuTorch cache outputs, not fixture pre-cache tensors.

diagnostics: Monolithic XNNPACK streaming entry exported but the host process terminated during execution without a Python exception.
Monolithic portable streaming entry failed because convolution received non-default rank-3 dim order.
Segmented first and cached XNNPACK entries both pass.
limitations: First and cached entry sets duplicate decoder weights on disk (about 2.76 GB combined in FP32).
Android execution and device-side cache transport remain step 8.
The ABI is fixed to batch 1, latent width 64, and one latent step per call.
The selected tolerances permit small XNNPACK intermediate/cache deviations while final PCM error remains below 1e-9.
